notes.title: New Demo Update Now Live for TPS Fest
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders!

We are excited to share that Disposable Corps is part of TPS Fest and the biggest demo update yet is now live. The highlight of this update is a brand-new buildable vehicle factory that lets you bring additional chaos to the battlefield.

Alongside the vehicle factory, the demo has been improved with better combat flow and balancing. This update delivers the clearest look so far at Disposable Corps’ unique mix of squad tactics and high-intensity firefights.

We’ve also put together a new gameplay trailer that gives the best look yet at Disposable Corps in action.
[previewyoutube="Nw5H4gRXjbQ;full"][/previewyoutube]


👉 Play the updated demo now and add Disposable Corps to your wishlist:


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579070/Disposable_Corps/"][/dynamiclink]


🎯 Want to go even deeper?

We’ll be running future closed playtests with new features that go beyond the demo. If you want to take part, sign up here: https://dc.lightup.games/



💬 Join the community:

Discord: https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN

QQ: 577020498



Thank you for checking out Disposable Corps during TPS Fest. We cannot wait to hear what you think of the new demo and the vehicle factory.

— Armoured Dudes

notes.title: [DEMO] Update – July Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569017/7b7ea11e70324935499fc41e1fd96a7ef19ef6cb.jpg"]

Greetings, Commander,


We’ve been hard at work squashing bugs, optimizing systems, and making sure your battles are smoother and more stable. Here’s what’s new in this update:


[previewyoutube="mbK5C0fL7Pw;full"][/previewyoutube]

🔧 Major Fixes & Optimizations[olist]
LOD Overhaul: Optimized character rendering by swapping to low-cost hard-surface meshes at long distances. Less lag, more action!

Network Sync Boost: New prediction and sync tech slashed NPC data load by up to 80%.

Physics Rework: Improved character physics to prevent crazy knockbacks and glitchy interactions from latency.

Shop Bug Fixed: You can now access the shop as intended. Time to gear up!

Clone Wars Ending (Mostly): Fixed the player clone bug — though a few ghosts still haunt the system occasionally.

Spawn Issues Resolved: Characters now reliably appear where they should.

No More NPC Mix-ups: Your character won’t accidentally become an NPC anymore.

Artillery Bug Fix: If you survive on a destroyed artillery seat, you’ll now keep your building rights.

Coordinate Sync Patch: Forced coordinate validation added to keep positions consistent across all clients.


[/olist][hr][/hr]

⚠️ Known Issues (Still Being Monitored):
Kill logs are a bit off — some AI kills are being counted as player kills.

Rare headless clones may still appear (we’re tracking it!).

A few NPCs believe they can fly — we’re working on grounding them.

Heavy artillery gunners might be invisible, but don’t worry — players can still operate them.


[hr][/hr]


Thank you, Commander, for leading the charge and helping us shape Disposable Corps through your feedback.


💬 Stay Connected
We’d love to hear more from you, whether it’s bug reports, feedback, or just a chat with fellow Commanders:

🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN

🔗 QQ: 577020498



More updates are on the horizon — stay alert and ready.

Until then, carry on.


— AD Dev Team
